item.text: The loader starts from `Default()` and only replaces fields for keys it finds. Both default fixtures omit `meta.check_for_updates`, so meeting the requested absent-key value and keeping those fixtures equal to `Default()` requires changing that default to `false`. I’ll add guarded reads for the three pool keys and the meta flag, then cover explicit values in the existing config tests.

The loader now reads all three DB pool keys and the meta flag, with field-for-field checks still covering both default fixtures. The advanced fixture covers nonzero pool values and an explicitly enabled update check; a separate fixture covers an explicitly disabled check. The config package tests pass. I’ll check the final diff and run the startup package tests.
